requirements.quote:
The unprotected payload of this
   packet contains the following CRYPTO frame, plus enough PADDING
   frames to make a 1162-byte payload:
requirements.condition: constructing the unprotected payload of the sample client Initial packet
requirements.required_behavior: append enough PADDING frames to make the payload exactly 1162 bytes
requirements.forbidden_behavior: produce a payload of a different length
requirements.why_checkable: The assembled unprotected payload length can be measured exactly.

requirements.condition: encoding the Length field of the sample client Initial header
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded Length field can be compared directly with 1182.

requirements.quote:
The header includes the connection ID and a packet number of 2:

   d36b3343cf088394c8f03e5157080000449e00000002
requirements.condition: encoding the unprotected header of the sample client Initial packet with packet number 2
requirements.why_checkable: The complete unprotected header is an exact byte-for-byte sample vector.

requirements.quote:
Because the header uses a 4-byte packet number encoding,
   the first 16 bytes of the protected payload is sampled and then
   applied to the header as follows:
requirements.condition: applying header protection to the sample header with a 4-byte packet-number encoding
requirements.required_behavior: use the first 16 bytes of the protected payload as the header-protection sample
requirements.why_checkable: The sample offset and 16-byte slice can be inspected during header protection.

requirements.condition: sampling the protected payload of the sample client Initial packet for header protection
requirements.why_checkable: The sampled bytes can be compared exactly with the known intermediate value.

requirements.condition: computing the sample client Initial header-protection mask with AES-ECB(hp, sample)[0..4]
requirements.why_checkable: This is an exact AES header-protection known-answer vector.

requirements.condition: applying the sample header-protection mask to header byte 0
requirements.required_behavior: XOR header[0] with mask[0] masked by 0x0f and obtain d7
requirements.why_checkable: The byte-level masking operation and result are exact intermediate values.

requirements.condition: applying the sample header-protection mask to the four packet-number bytes
requirements.required_behavior: XOR header[18..21] with mask[1..4] and obtain a0c95e82
requirements.why_checkable: The packet-number masking operation and four-byte result are exact intermediate values.

requirements.condition: after applying header protection to the sample client Initial header
requirements.why_checkable: The protected header can be compared byte-for-byte with the sample vector.
